name: To Find A Home
source:
Congratulations, you have just been evicted! Nowhere to sleep tonight? Here, just follow this ad's directions - don't worry, the vampire won't bite... not unless you ask them to.

Enter the 137 Moonlit Avenue - all guests welcome!

Get judged by the snarky, dandy ghost. Meet the demon cat. Flirt, banter and argue with your roommates. Feed the poor, starved vampire, get wild with the werewolf or have a sweet heart-to-heart with the witch. 

[From [url=https://ravenmythinteractive.itch.io/to-find-a-home]itch.io[/url]]
